title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 293 (Monitoring of winding up)

content.overview: The Tribunal monitors the winding up and may call for information from the company liquidator.

sections.heading: Rule
sections.body: The Tribunal monitors the winding up and may call for information from the company liquidator.

sections.heading: Explanation
sections.body: Monitoring can lead to directions or to removal under section 276. It does not reopen a completed dissolution except by a separate proceeding.
